# On-Page SEO Checklist

Apply this to each SEO page while preserving the website's voice and usefulness.

## Intent And Content

- Page satisfies the search intent visible in the SERP.
- Primary keyword appears naturally in the first 100 words.
- Content answers the main query directly before expanding.
- Page includes original business context: examples, proof, opinions, stats, stories, or local details.
- No generic AI filler openings or unsupported claims.
- No keyword stuffing or awkward repeated phrases.
- Content is not a near-duplicate of another page.

## Metadata

- Exactly one H1.
- Title tag is unique, compelling, and includes the primary keyword.
- Meta description is unique, useful, and includes a reason to click.
- Slug is short, readable, and includes the primary keyword when natural.
- Canonical URL is present for public SEO pages.
- Open Graph/Twitter metadata is present when the site supports it.

## Structure

- H2/H3 structure matches the topic depth expected by the SERP.
- Most sections answer one clear sub-question.
- FAQ section includes 4 to 8 real questions when useful.
- CTA appears near the top, middle or end where appropriate.
- Blog pages include a next step toward a service, product, lead form, or related article.
- Service pages include direct conversion paths such as phone, quote, booking, or contact form.

## Links

- 3 to 5 relevant internal links when enough pages exist.
- 2 to 3 trustworthy external links when useful for the topic.
- Anchor text is descriptive, not "click here".
- New page is linked from at least one crawlable existing page or index.
- Related pages link back where appropriate.

## Media

- Images are relevant, licensed, optimized, and not decorative filler.
- Image dimensions are stable to avoid layout shift.
- Alt text describes the image and context without stuffing keywords.
- Hero image or primary visual fits the page intent and design system.

## Schema

Use only schema that matches visible page content:

- BlogPosting or Article for blog pages.
- Service for service pages.
- LocalBusiness when the business details are real and present.
- FAQPage only when FAQ content is visible.
- BreadcrumbList when breadcrumbs exist.

## Conversion Quality

- CTA copy matches visitor intent.
- Trust proof appears before or near conversion points.
- Forms remain short enough for the page intent.
- Contact details are consistent with the rest of the site.
